scope: QR Upgrade local-first web, Android and iOS prototype
frameworks: SOC 2 readiness: security; other categories subject to approved scope
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 readiness, subject to ISMS and Statement of Applicability
OWASP ASVS 5.0.0 selected web/API controls; not a full verification
OWASP MASVS selected mobile controls; device verification outstanding
GDPR and Australian APP applicability review; no legal compliance claim

automated.title: Cloudflare runtime and clean artifact boundaries
automated.method: Isolated Next/OpenNext build, dry-run size checks, output secret scan and local workerd nonce, headers, binding and signed-webhook checks

automated.title: Static security analysis
automated.method: Semgrep TypeScript, React and Node.js rules

manual.title: Scope, legal entity and accountable security owner
manual.requiredEvidence: Define entity, customers, services, data and exclusions; approve scope and assign named owners.

manual.title: Risk register and policy approval
manual.requiredEvidence: Approve this risk register, treatment decisions, security policies, residual risks and review cadence.

manual.title: Workforce security and offboarding
manual.requiredEvidence: Training, confidentiality agreements, role checks and an observed joiner/mover/leaver workflow.

manual.title: Production identity, MFA and least privilege
manual.requiredEvidence: Prove SSO/MFA and least privilege on GitHub, hosting, DNS, secrets, Apple, Google and Expo; record emergency access.

manual.title: Access reviews and service-credential rotation
manual.requiredEvidence: Review active memberships and service accounts; evidence credential rotation/revocation and owner sign-off.

manual.title: Protected repository and deployment approvals
manual.requiredEvidence: Protected branches, required security checks, independent review, restricted production environment and no direct ungated deploys.

manual.title: Hosting, WAF, TLS and secret-manager configuration
manual.requiredEvidence: Verify production domains, TLS, rate limiting before authentication, network restrictions, secret storage and quota-outage behavior.

manual.title: Security logging, alerts and retention
manual.requiredEvidence: Verify access-controlled central logs, privacy redaction, retention/deletion, actionable alerts and a test alert delivered to an owner.

manual.title: Backups, recovery and continuity
manual.requiredEvidence: Test source/configuration and D1/private-R2 customer data recovery together, including publication state and object references. Record service rollback, measured RTO/RPO, backup access, retention and owner approval.

manual.title: Incident and breach-response exercise
manual.requiredEvidence: Assign escalation contacts; run a tabletop; validate notifications, investigation, evidence preservation and legal decision points.

manual.title: Vendor reviews and contractual controls
manual.requiredEvidence: Verify actual processors and regions, contracts/DPAs, subprocessors, access and review outcomes. Do not list unconfigured vendors as active.

manual.title: Privacy applicability, notice and data rights
manual.requiredEvidence: Approve legal entity/markets, controller/processor roles, applicable law, retention, transfer safeguards, privacy notice, rights handling and DPIA screening.

manual.title: Endpoint and asset security
manual.requiredEvidence: Inventory operator devices and systems; evidence encryption, patching, malware protection and access revocation.

manual.title: Independent penetration test and remediation
manual.requiredEvidence: Obtain a scoped web/API/mobile assessment and retest significant findings; cover upload handling, XSS, rate limits and mobile leakage.

manual.title: Physical native-device validation
manual.requiredEvidence: On iOS and Android validate permissions, background/snapshot privacy, files/exports, no cleartext traffic, backup settings and camera behavior.

manual.title: Signed native artifacts and store disclosures
manual.requiredEvidence: Record APK/AAB/IPA hashes, release signing identities, no debug signing, binary manifests, privacy declarations, store data-safety disclosures and review approval.

manual.title: Vulnerability response and dependency licenses
manual.requiredEvidence: Approve license inventory and patch targets; record triage ownership and evidence that scan failures reach the responsible person.

manual.title: Working vulnerability-reporting channel
manual.requiredEvidence: Verify a monitored private reporting channel, owner, response target, triage and escalation; publish accurate contact information.

manual.title: Enterprise data-feature launch approval
manual.requiredEvidence: Approve actual individual-account/cloud-design/dynamic-link/hosted-content/AI scope and intended billing activation. Enterprise rollout requires tenant isolation, SSO/MFA/RBAC, audit trails, retention/deletion and supplier/privacy reviews with real operational evidence.
